notes: Posted 22 June 2001, before Coruscant; the list has no Coruscant-set card, so the format is Premiere - Tatooine.

Starting cards as marked '(starting)' in the list: the Objective, Tatooine: Podrace Arena (Dark), Executor: Holotheatre, Executor: Meditation Chamber, Epic Duel, Boonta Eve Podrace (Dark), Sebulba's Podracer, Start Your Engines!, Visage Of The Emperor (posted '2x (starting)'; the Objective deploys one) and Watto's Box; all count toward the 60. Visage Of The Emperor is shown as the starting effect because the Objective deploys it.
Start Your Engines! and Epic Duel were listed under Interrupts and Epic Events but missed by the machine draft; added as posted.

Posted 'Emperor Palpitine' dested Emperor Palpatine; 'Darth Maul' the Tatooine Darth Maul; 'Dr. Evazan & Bonda Boba' Dr. Evazan & Ponda Baba; 'U-3PO' U-3PO (Yoo-Threepio); 'Bossk In Hounds Tooth' Bossk In Hound's Tooth; 'Security Percautions' Security Precautions.

Posted 'Tatooine Cantina', 'Tatooine Podrace Arena', 'Jabba's Palace Audience Chamber', 'Endor Back Door' and 'Boonta Eve Podrace' in a Dark deck dested the Dark pages; 'Vader's Lightsaber' the Premiere Vader's Lightsaber.
Fanfare and Secret Plans are the 2001 Effects (not Defensive Shields).

Post-list 'DECK EDIT': Dr. Evazan & Ponda Baba, There'll Be Hell To Pay, Pit Crews, Bad Feeling Have I, Fanfare and Hit Racer taken out for Alter 2x, Alter & Collateral Damage 2x and Sense & Uncertain Is The Future 2x. The page shows the list as posted; the edit is noted only.
